messages:
harper: observed weird streaming failures where final JSON parse fails only when multilingual tokens are used. UI shows "Unexpected end of JSON input" and hangs.

zain: which sdk/sampleapp/version? any raw bytes?

harper: sampleapp web demo with browser sdk v0.9.4. Repro: send multibyte unicode token (emoji/4-byte chars) and throttle network. Sometimes the chunk boundary splits a UTF-8 codepoint; our SSE parser slices buffers by byte offsets and then JSON.parse fails. Local runs without throttling never hit it.

rachel: Oof. So two problems: 1) parser assumes chunk boundaries align with character boundaries; 2) when client disconnects mid-codepoint we may flush an invalid partial sequence and JSON.parse explodes.

zain: For node we can use StringDecoder from 'string_decoder' to decode streaming buffers safely. For browser, the TextDecoder API has a streaming mode (TextDecoder.decode(chunk, {stream: true})) that preserves partial multibyte sequences.

harper: Good call. Also need EOF-flush semantics: if stream closes while decoder has a pending partial, we should finalize the decode (TextDecoder.decode()) which will replace invalid sequences with U+FFFD or error depending on options. Better to surface a replace char than crash.

rachel: Add these fixes plus idle-flush to avoid hanging UI on flaky networks. Proposed changes: - switch parser to byte-buffer -> streaming decode (TextDecoder stream / StringDecoder) - assemble SSE by lines after decoding, not by raw bytes - on EOF, finalize decoder and flush partial event as best-effort JSON (and surface parse error metric) - expose config idle_flush_ms (default 600ms) so apps can opt for aggressive flushing on mobile VPNs.

zain: Don't forget JSON-safe fallback: if final decode yields invalid JSON, emit a structured partial event like {"__partial":true, "text":"..."} so apps can render progress instead of crashing. Also increment a metric so we can alert on high rates.

harper: Repro script: `node tools/simulate-multibyte-split.js --throttle 50 --emoji "\u{1F4A9}\u{1F60A}"` and curl headless to reproduce. I'll attach a minimal mitmproxy rule that splits UTF-8 sequences.

rachel: Add unit tests for Node/Browser/Go parity: multibyte split mid-codepoint, EOF mid-codepoint, and duplicate/reordered chunks. For browser, test using headless chrome with TextDecoder streaming.

insights-bot: opensource-ci: branch fix/sse-utf8-streaming created. Tests queued.

zain: Will open PR with code changes and small README note: "Troubleshooting: multilingual streaming hangs" with the repro command and explanation about proxies that split bytes. Also add sampleapp flag `--simulate-utf8-split`.

harper: One more UX thing: update onboarding quickstart to mention common proxy/network pitfalls (truncation, resegmentation, multibyte splits) and include the small script so new devs can diagnose quickly. Saves support time.

insights-bot: CI: build 5220 passed. Merged to main. Release note: "SDKs: improved SSE decoding for UTF-8 multibyte sequences across chunk boundaries; streaming parser now uses streaming decoders (TextDecoder/StringDecoder), finalizes on EOF, emits best-effort partial events on decode errors, and adds configurable idle-flush. See sampleapp README for repro and troubleshooting."
